name: Réserve
source:
Réserve is a short Japanese erotic adventure game with RPG-style combat. The player controls Mio, a young woman who is about to go on a date when she suddenly falls into a portal which transports her to another world. A fairy-like creature tells her that she may be able to return to her world upon reaching a portal in a nearby forest, but she will have to get past all kinds of perverted monsters first.

The player must guide Mio, represented by an icon, through the world map. Occasionally, a monster will appear, which will cause Mio to go into battle mode. In battle mode, the player must guess which parts of the monster will be most effective to attack until it is defeated. Getting two answers wrong in a row will result in a game over screen depicting Mio being molested by the monster in question.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/230567/reserve/]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《Réserve》是一款日本短篇色情冒险游戏，战斗系统采用RPG风格。玩家操控年轻女性美绪。她正要去约会，却突然掉进一个把她送往异世界的传送门。一只仙子般的生物告诉她，只要抵达附近森林里的传送门，就有可能回到自己的世界；不过，她必须先通过各种淫乱怪物的阻拦。

玩家要在世界地图上引导图标代表的美绪前进。途中偶尔会出现怪物，美绪随即进入战斗模式。玩家必须猜测攻击怪物的哪些部位最有效，直到将其击败。连续答错两次就会游戏结束，画面会显示美绪遭该怪物猥亵。

[来源：[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/230567/reserve/]MobyGames[/url]]
